item.title: Book review: The Software Engineer's Guidebook
item.description: Seeing a lot of praise for Gergely Orosz’s “The Software Engineer’s Guidebook”, I was pleased when I found the book under the Christmas Tree. Unfortunately, in my opinion, it does not live up to the hype. The book, not the tree. I’m not sure who’s the target of this book. It consists of a “career fundamentals” intro, four chapters, and a conclusion. Each chapter is intended for an engineer being on a specific level, starting with “the competent software developer” and ending with “role-model staff and principal engineers”.
